author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Claude Projects step by step. In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to create a project in Claude, upload files, add project instructions, organize chats, and use Claude Projects as a custom AI workspace.

Claude Projects helps you keep related conversations, files, and instructions together in one place, so Claude understands the context across all your chats. Whether you're using Claude for work, research, coding, marketing, school, or business, Projects can help you stay organized and more productive.

In this video, you'll learn how to:
- Create a new Claude Project
- Add project instructions
- Upload files and documents
- Use files as context across chats
- Organize and manage conversations
- Move chats into projects
- Archive old projects

Host: Kevin Stratvert

📚 RESOURCES
- Get Claude: https://www.claude.ai
